text:
nina: PolarisGrid reached out — they want a co-published benchmark focused on watt-efficiency and end-to-end 99p latency. They asked if we can include kernel tuning notes and the marketplace tile.

chris: 👍 we should require reproducible artifacts: raw CSVs, kernel commit hash, cooling config, and a 3-run mean/std. Also recommend calling out sequence length and KV-cache policy.

lee: From infra: to be comparable across partners we must standardize measurement points: wall watts at PDU, averaged across steady-state window (300s), report stddev. I can add a quick script to scrape PDUs and align timestamps.

polaris-eng: We'll provide rack diagram and our recommended CRAC setpoint. Quick ask: can you include a short note in the tile about the kernel micro-optimizations so readers understand the uplift is from a tuned build?

nina: Yes — marketing wants a one-liner that is conservative. Tile should only show verified numbers. Blog can include the kernel note and the config snippet. Legal will review the co-announcement. ops-bot, open legal ticket please.

ops-bot: Created LEGAL-741. Estimated review: 48h. Calendar invite for Wed 10am PT cross-org smoke call sent.

chris: Proposed acceptance thresholds for the marketplace tile (must be met in 3 runs):
- sustained throughput >= 9.5k tokens/s per rack
- watt-efficiency >= 12 tokens/s/W (mean across runs)
- p99 end-to-end <= 260ms at 512 context
If any metric fails but shows consistent uplift with the kernel, we can include a conditional line in the blog. Tile remains strict.

lee: I'll standardize the bench command and logger. Using bench_v2 so results include perf counters + PDU watt. Example smoke command: 

```
# reproducible smoke
bench_v2 --model=redwood-10b --seq=512 --warmup=180 --steady=300 \
  --runs=3 --collect=tokens_per_s,p99_latency,pdu_watts \
  --kernel=layout-prefetch-experimental --out=artifacts/polaris-grid.csv
```

polaris-eng: We'll slot an engineer on Wed 10am PT and prep our rack spec + hero image (16:9) by Tue EOD. We'll also export PDU wiring notes.

nina: Good. Marketing/PR: draft tile copy but hold until legal signoff. Ops: keep raw artifacts un-redacted in the shared folder; marketing will request a sanitized package for public.

chris: One more thing — add a short reproducibility section in the artifact bundle describing K/V cache warmup steps and network topology (switch aggregation) so customers can replicate.

lee: Action items:
- lee: bench script + PDU scraper and run 3x sweeps (due: Tue 4pm PT)
- polaris-eng: rack spec + hero image (due: Tue EOD)
- nina: coordinate legal + marketing and hold the tile draft (in progress)
- ops-bot: legal ticket/call invite (done)

polaris-eng: We'll also provide a small note about our airflow and instrumented fan curves so you can add it to the "how we tested" doc.

nina: Locking Wed 10am PT for the cross-org smoke. If numbers land above thresholds we'll cut the artifact package and send to Polaris for sign-off. If something slips, flag here and we'll triage. :white_check_mark:
